authority_kind.purpose: Authorize one operation-scoped temporal comparison over exactly identified anchors: joint comparability, lawful order disposition, and the ceiling of any resulting directional claim.

minimality.required_ceiling_if_implemented: operation-scoped comparability and ordering of exactly identified temporal anchors for one governed use; may emit a bounded TEMPORAL_RELATION_RECEIPT; no F8 consumption, source selection/equivalence creation, pooling, interpolation, cause, trend, trajectory, scalar temporal pressure, or actor inference

required_inputs.failure: TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_ANCHORS if fewer than two authorized anchors

required_inputs.required_when: temporal_order_disposition is CALENDAR_TOTAL_ORDER, FAMILY_LOCAL_ORDINAL, or PARTIAL_ORDER_NO_DIRECTION

required_inputs.note: one observation per anchor; no observation is authored by this authority

required_inputs.resolution_path: source-relation owner path, not temporal owner

no_authorized_change.definition: exact signed delta == 0 under the authorized difference operation

exact_claim_ceiling.may_assert: For one governed use, exactly identified comparable anchors form one authorized ordered comparison; where the authorized basis permits direction, the exact signed delta on one exact quantity/estimand/measure surface determines INCREASE, DECREASE, or exact-zero NO_AUTHORIZED_CHANGE.

cross_universe_two_path_law.same_universe: temporal path only; SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE is neither required nor inferred
cross_universe: source-relation path independently resolves an exact positive SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE authority using its existing relation-authority discipline
temporal path independently resolves exact positive TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY and consumes the already-resolved source_equivalence_ref as a prerequisite
cross_universe_two_path_law.noncollapse: SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE does not imply TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY and TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY may not mint SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE
